title: French Yogurt Flatbread
description: A simple French-inspired flatbread topped with yogurt, a Kenyan twist. Perfect for a quick snack or appetizer.
instructions: Place the flatbread on a baking sheet.
Drizzle with a little water and sprinkle with salt.
Bake for 10-12 minutes or until crispy.
Remove the flatbread from the oven and let it cool slightly.
Spread the Kenyan yogurt over the flatbread.
Add oozing (honey or maple syrup) to taste.
